instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Quantum Labs is a specialized management consulting firm focusing on digital transformation and operational efficiency for mid-to-large enterprises across sectors like finance and healthcare. With a team of 40 senior consultants, the firm leverages deep domain expertise to guide clients through complex change initiatives. The current focus is rapidly expanding its footprint by embedding AI-driven insights into core service delivery models.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer built an internal dashboard to visualize our order backlog, which the operations team found useful. However, this was an informal side project with no official support or maintenance plan. When that engineer left, the dashboard became unreliable and was eventually abandoned. We learned that good ideas need institutional backing to survive.
answers.strategicGoals: Growth is our existential mandate. We are losing market share to faster-moving competitors and need to reignite our growth trajectory by increasing high-margin service offerings. We are willing to make significant strategic bets, such as niche vertical specialization or targeted M&A in adjacent technology firms, provided they have a credible path to meaningful revenue contribution within 18 months.
answers.additionalContext: We are in the final stages of being acquired by a larger international group. The deal is expected to close in 3 months. The acquiring company has a strong reputation for technology-driven operations, and we anticipate significant investment in modernizing our systems post-acquisition. In the interim, we are in a holding pattern rather than aggressive market disruption.
answers.teamSize: Our digital and innovation organization includes 80+ professionals across centers of excellence for AI/ML, cloud engineering, UX design, and agile delivery. We run an internal incubator program that has graduated 6 new digital products to market in the past 2 years, alongside a corporate venture capital arm that makes strategic minority investments in relevant startups.

opportunities.title: Knowledge Management AI Integration for Proposals
opportunities.rationale: Integrating an AI tool to rapidly surface and synthesize past engagement data would drastically reduce the time spent on proposal development, directly supporting growth goals. This is a low-risk incremental win that leverages existing digital resources.

first_actions: Select and pilot three specific AI tools (e.g., LLM fine-tuning) for content summarization.
Define the required data ingestion pipeline from historical project files.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average proposal development time by 30% within Q3.
milestones: Month 1: Tool selection and data mapping complete.
Month 2: Pilot deployment with a defined consultant group.

opportunities.title: Standardized Service Blueprint Framework
opportunities.rationale: Formalizing service delivery templates across all departments will reduce project variability, improve quality consistency, and significantly lower onboarding time for new consultants. This stabilizes the core business while supporting growth.

first_actions: Create a cross-functional working group (Consulting & Ops).
Develop a 'Tier 1' standardized blueprint covering engagement scope and delivery milestones.
resources_needed: Training workshops for all consultants (internal cost: $3k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 80% adherence to the standardized blueprint in new engagements.
milestones: Month 1-2: Blueprint draft completion and internal review.
Month 3: Rollout and mandatory training for all consultants.

opportunities.title: Niche Vertical Automation Pivot
opportunities.rationale: Given the conservative appetite and budget, this bold opportunity involves testing a highly automated 'Productized Service' within an existing high-demand niche (e.g., AI implementation for mid-market logistics). This tests new revenue streams without requiring massive capital expenditure or organizational restructuring.

first_actions: Identify one specific, repeatable consulting need with low complexity and high perceived value.
Launch a 'Quantum Accelerator' pilot team to deliver the service as a packaged product.
resources_needed: Small dedicated MVP tech stack for automation ($15k)
External subject matter expert consultancy (phased approach)
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure two pilot clients paying a premium price of $X per project.
milestones: Month 1-2: Pilot definition and MVP feature lock.
Month 4: Launch and initial revenue generation review.

next_steps.action: Establish a formal 'Innovation Steering Committee' composed of senior leaders.
Run a comprehensive audit of current operational processes to identify the top three friction points for growth.
Allocate dedicated seed funding ($50k) for one radical pilot project (e.g., Vertical Automation Pivot).

key_weaknesses: Fragmented and informal innovation process leading to inconsistent output.
Organizational inertia and slow decision-making due to varied approval structures.
Heavy reliance on senior talent, creating potential bottlenecks for scaling digital initiatives.
Inconsistent maintenance of early internal projects, undermining institutional knowledge capture.
